Night bulletin for anyone with a companion animal
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should confirm their animal's booking details and care needs before arrival so our team can prepare a safe and steady journey.

Our desk coordinates care from booking through pickup, and the senior coordinator and welfare coordinator review comfort needs with attention to species, temperament, and travel conditions. If a connection is missed, <<FACT F110>> We will guide you through the next steps with calm, practical support and keep the animal's welfare at the center of the plan.

Please also remember that any concern about an escape in transit should be raised promptly. <<FACT F120>> The sooner you speak with us, the sooner we can check the record, review handling notes, and assist with the report in a careful and orderly way.

If your companion is traveling tonight, keep documents close and make the desk your first stop for any concern. Companion Animal Travel Desk
